subjects: native worker robot speed absolute-cap ownership
scope.not_a_claim: This record does not establish an MIR5 implementation, a native run result, or save-upgrade acceptance.

published_byte_verification.method: SHA-256 of each archive entry equals SHA-256 of git cat-file blob v4.7.0:<source path>; no extraction or engine execution.

activation_boundary.policy: exact-current-K2/K2SO tuple; MIR owns powder only

public_technologies.configured_unit_contract: The visible stream and each state holder use the same configured cost, formula/time and science-unit authority; do not substitute a fixed default. The continuation fallback anchors at level 4 from the early model's evaluated next-level cost.

carrier_contract.post_reconciliation: A fresh/default or consumed carrier is disabled, invisible, unresearched, unqueued and reset to its own initial level with zero saved progress. A carrier is never a player research path.
carrier_contract.shape_guard: A holder is admitted only if hidden, carries exactly the powder effect, has a positive research unit with a count or formula and nonempty unique positive ingredients. Planned unit fields must match the visible configured unit before emission.

state_transfer.earned_effect_invariant: Each completed MIR powder level remains 0.02: three early levels plus the first continuation level yield 0.08; the native crystal bonus remains independently 0.10.
state_transfer.queue_and_progress: Map only carrier queue/current identities to the matching public technology, preserve mapped fractional progress after readback, and roll back every state mutation if queue/current/progress readback fails.
state_transfer.missing_or_invalid_destination: Remove only carrier queue entries and retain hidden disabled holders plus the record; do not manufacture an unsafe public research path. If the player later changes the remaining queue, restore owned earned state but never replay the old queue.
state_transfer.finite_only_destination: If the finite early stage is valid but continuation is unavailable, retain any later tail in the hidden continuation holder, disabled and unqueued, until a valid continuation can consume it.

native_owner_admission.rejection: No finite cap binding is created when no exact candidate satisfies every check, including a candidate with an extra effect.

finite_cap_contract.queue_strategy: remove only current or queued levels above the cap; retain valid fractional progress
finite_cap_contract.completed_bonuses: retain completed levels and worker-speed bonuses
finite_cap_contract.presentation: make a disabled above-cap technology visible while disabled; restore owned visibility on relaxation

per_force_ownership_state.disable_record: MIR records an enablement restoration right only after it changes enabled=true to enabled=false, with policy version, exact force index, ownership key/kind, binding fingerprint and enabled_before_cap=true.
per_force_ownership_state.relaxation: MIR re-enables only when the recorded disable belongs to the same force and policy and enabled_before_cap=true. It separately restores only MIR-owned visibility.
per_force_ownership_state.foreign_disabled_case: If technology.enabled was already false, cap enforcement may own the temporary visibility change but does not create a disable ownership record; removing the cap leaves enabled=false and restores the prior visibility.
per_force_ownership_state.v2_migration_exception: Only the exact recognized V2 visibility-without-disable shape is retained once as unowned-disable continuity. It is never general MIR enablement ownership.
per_force_ownership_state.force_lifecycle: Force reset clears that force's records before reconciliation; a force merge clears the removed source index so a reused index cannot inherit disablement ownership.

fixture_contract.positive_case: cap 10, technology level 10: remove the second queued level-11 occurrence while keeping technology enabled and worker_robots_speed_modifier unchanged; at level 11 disable it without changing earned bonuses.
fixture_contract.owned_relaxation: cap 0 restores enabled=true and visible_when_disabled=false only after MIR's own level-11 disable record.
fixture_contract.foreign_relaxation: cap 0 leaves a pre-disabled level-11 native technology disabled and restores its original visibility.
fixture_contract.malformed_tail: an extra native effect produces no managed binding and no queue/enablement mutation.
